nodes.label: Web UI
nodes.summary: React single-page app (built by Vite) where the user picks a project, chats with Claude Code, approves tool calls, edits rules and navigates code maps.

nodes.label: App Shell
nodes.summary: Sidebar with project picker, add-project form, chat list and navigation between map, chat and settings views.

nodes.label: Chat View
nodes.summary: Shows one chat's replayed and live feed, approval cards, Discuss/Build mode and model choice, and the message composer.

nodes.label: Map View
nodes.summary: Renders a project's generated diagrams with React Flow and ELK layout, with drill-down, stale-node highlighting and generation controls.

nodes.label: File Viewer
nodes.summary: Read-only viewer for the files and directories behind a map node.

nodes.label: Project Settings
nodes.summary: Edits a project's allow/ask/deny approval rules and its default Discuss/Build models.

nodes.label: API Client
nodes.summary: Thin typed fetch wrapper for the Flightdeck API that validates responses against the shared contracts.

nodes.label: Flightdeck Server
nodes.summary: Loopback-only Hono server that serves the UI and API, runs Claude Code turns and map generations, and answers Claude Code's PreToolUse hook.

nodes.label: HTTP API
nodes.summary: Hono routes for projects, chats, rules, approvals, maps and files, the SSE chat feed, the two hook endpoints and static serving of the built UI.

nodes.label: Chat Runner
nodes.summary: Runs each chat turn as a headless `claude -p` process with the hook settings, tracks the run, enforces the subscription tripwire and supports stop.

nodes.label: Approval Hook
nodes.summary: Decides every tool call of a chat run: Discuss-mode refusal, per-project edit lock, project rules, then a held approval card the user clicks.

nodes.label: Rules Engine
nodes.summary: Matches tool calls against Claude Code-style allow/ask/deny patterns and suggests patterns for "always allow".

nodes.label: Map Generator
nodes.summary: Spawns a read-only Claude Code agent that returns a map as structured output, validates it, stores it and computes which nodes changed since its commit.

nodes.label: Chat Feed
nodes.summary: Append-only per-chat event log with replay and in-memory live subscribers for SSE.

nodes.label: File Access
nodes.summary: Read-only file and directory listing confined to the project folder, never exposing .git.

nodes.label: DB Schema
nodes.summary: Drizzle table definitions plus boot-time DDL, column migrations and cleanup of runs and approvals left open by a restart.

nodes.label: Config
nodes.summary: Environment-driven settings: loopback host and port, data dir, claude binary path, default model and approval timeout.

nodes.label: Shared Contracts
nodes.summary: Zod schemas and types shared by server and UI for API payloads, feed items, Claude stream events, hook payloads and maps.

nodes.label: SQLite Database
nodes.summary: flightdeck.db in the data dir (WAL) holding projects, rules, chats, runs and the approvals audit trail.

nodes.label: Chat Feed Files
nodes.summary: One JSONL file per chat under the data dir that holds the chat's full event history for replay.

nodes.label: Stored Maps
nodes.summary: Validated map JSON written to `.flightdeck/<view>.json` inside each project repo, tagged with the commit it was made from.

nodes.label: Project Repositories
nodes.summary: The git repositories on the box that Flightdeck manages; inspected with git for HEAD, file lists and diffs, and read for the file viewer.

nodes.label: Claude Code CLI
nodes.summary: The unmodified `claude` binary run headless on the subscription, both for chat turns and for map generation, calling back into Flightdeck's hook before every tool use.

edges.label: releases edit lock, cancels pending cards
